strengths: Correctly identifies the dendritic cell lineage from MHC class II and antigen-presentation markers.
Explicitly recognizes CD1C/FCER1A/CLEC10A as a cDC2/CD1c+ DC combination.
Reasonably excludes monocyte, cDC1, pDC, basophil, and lymphocyte alternatives.
weaknesses: Top1 label is generic dendritic cell; the more specific cDC2/CD1c+ call is relegated to an unmapped second-rank label.
RNASE2 is mentioned only as a minor caveat without a clear eosinophil exclusion.

strengths: Top1 dendritic cell is directly supported by HLA-DQA1/HLA-DRB1, CD1C, CLEC10A, and CD86.
Includes CD1c-positive myeloid dendritic cell (CL:0002399) as a top-k candidate, matching the final refined call.
weaknesses: Top1 remains generic dendritic cell despite strong cDC2/CD1c+ evidence.
The exact subtype call is rank 2 with a lower candidate score (0.6 vs 0.95).

strengths: Top1 captures the cDC2 specificity supported by FCER1A, CLEC10A, CD1C, CD33, and CD86.
Correctly rejects T/NK identity based on absence of CD3D/CD8A/FGFBP2/FCGR3A.
MHC class II and antigen-processing enrichment terms reinforce professional APC identity.
weaknesses: The cDC2 label is mapped to CL:0000990 (conventional dendritic cell), losing the CD1c-positive specificity represented by CL:0002399.
Top-k includes an unsupported connective tissue cell candidate.

supporting: Top DEGs FCER1A, CLEC10A, CD1C, HLA-DQA1, HLA-DRB1, HLA-DRA, CD33, and CD86 directly support a conventional myeloid dendritic cell / cDC2 identity.
CD1C is directly positive, supporting hierarchical refinement from dendritic cell (CL:0000451) to CD1c-positive myeloid dendritic cell (CL:0002399).
Absence of pDC markers (LILRA4, CLEC4C, IRF7) and cDC1 markers (CLEC9A, XCR1) supports the conventional DC branch.
PMID 37407551 and 34680286 in the original evidence support cDC2/CD1c+ DC interpretation.
conflicting: RNASE2 is an eosinophil-associated transcript, but no other eosinophil markers (CLC, CPA3, MS4A2) are present, so it is not lineage-defining.
No CD14, LYZ, S100A8/9, FCN1, or VCAN is observed, so a monocyte or DC3-dominant interpretation is not favored.
enrichment_or_literature: MHC class II protein complex assembly
Antigen processing and presentation of exogenous peptide antigen via MHC class II
Positive regulation of T cell activation
